checks: clean workspaces adopt newer webhook data on refresh
unsaved local edits prevent background replacement
edits made while a remote refresh is loading remain intact
edits during regional restoration are saved rather than falsely marked synchronized
a communication response never overwrites editing that began during its request
same-tab navigation loads newer shared data automatically when the last local revision is clean
navigation preserves a dirty local workspace when the remote document has also changed
switching organizations pauses synchronization before sending the previous document
method: In-memory authenticated workspace adapter with delayed reads and writes. No real organization or network.
